payload.text: hv, 19 Oct 2026, directly to vc, about 15:07Z: "Ok, continue. I'm AFK for a while. You have the pen. I want utilz issues fixed and the release cut, please. Or ready to cut, at least. And I don't want CI/CD failing for some arbitrary slipup reason." vc's reading. (1) Drive every open Utilz issue that can finish without hv to landed and checked: 0083's three parts (dc, ic, cc), 0084 and 0087 (cc), and 0073 (ic). (2) This is the yes for ic's START A, the diagnostic install. It is reversible, since START B puts hv's build back as 0.4.2, and its launch note in menuz.log tells ic what the row reads, so the fix's design can proceed before hv's look. hv's look stays the condition for closing 0073. (3) Ready to cut means the final head passes a local twin of every CI job: tests.yml's Ubuntu loop and shellcheck 0.9.0 on kovacs; the macOS suites here; cargo build, test and acceptance on both OSes; cargo fmt and clippy -D warnings on Linux; and the menuz app build and test here, plus utilz-dc's release dry run. The push, the dispatch at that head (menuz-app runs only on a tag or a dispatch, and its macos-26 Xcode 26.6 differs from this Mac's 27.1), the cut and the tap stay hv's. (4) 0072 waits on Gtools' WP-09, which hv holds, and 0075 on hv's logout after the cut. Neither can finish without hv, so the cut is ready without them unless hv says otherwise.
